## What it catches

Delivery layer importing server layer.

## As `layout({ scope: "@hosti/" })` builds it

```json
{
  "name": "delivery-does-not-import-server",
  "severity": "error",
  "from": {
    "path": "^apps/[^/]+/src/delivery(?:/|$)"
  },
  "to": {
    "path": "^apps/[^/]+/src/server(?:/|$)"
  }
}
```
